profiles.name: batch
profiles.says: A file in, a report and a normalised file out. The host reads bytes as UTF-8, enforces the 1 MiB limit before parsing, and publishes exports atomically.

host.export: staged then published atomically; an interrupted publish exposes nothing

profiles.name: canvas
profiles.says: A fixed-tick game: the host delivers events in order (tick with the sampled input, launch, pause, resume, restart) and draws the returned list. The graph owns every rule; the host owns capture, scheduling, rendering and sound.

host.tick: 60 ticks per second; each tick is one frame(state, {kind:"tick", move, target}) call; move is the sampled keyboard intent −1|0|1, target the touch x in field units or −1
host.catchUp: after a host delay at most 3 ticks are run per animation frame and the remainder is discarded; the game never jumps
host.pause: no tick is delivered while the game reports phase paused; pause/resume are events; resume never replays elapsed time
host.restart: restart is an event; the host clears its sampled input and its queued events before delivering it
host.input: keyboard: arrows or A/D move, space launches or resumes, P pauses, R restarts; touch: drag sets target, tap launches or resumes; the canvas has touch-action none so the page does not scroll
host.trace: the host records every delivered event in order and can replay them from initial() to compare the final state identity
host.render: primitives rect, circle, ring, text with named colours; the host scales the 32000 × 48000 field to the viewport and never computes a collision or repairs state
host.audio: optional short synthesized sounds for wall, paddle, brick, lost, win, launch; failure to play never touches state

profiles.name: panel
profiles.says: A panel of buttons, inputs, tables and text rendered by the host; events come back as records. Session state is kept by the host and survives reload within a test session.

host.events: the host sends {kind ...} records named by event directives; inputs are echoed into the event
host.state: the host keeps the last returned state; a refusal keeps the previous state

simulator.ledger: readable by tests (window.__dnode.sim.ledger), never by the graph

host.session: the host keeps the whole state in browser storage under the main root identity; reload restores it; Clear session resets to initial()
host.items: notice errors steps hero section text warn status card line row total button order table file log — rendered generically; area places an item under shop, orders or desk
host.money: amounts are shown exactly as the graph formats them; the host never computes a price

profiles.name: pure
profiles.says: Pure computation: no effects, no entry points. For conformance roots and shared libraries.
